decision: The Owner platform is accepted at +15.00 m +- 0.15 m; structural fill below +14.85 m is paid by the Owner at the unit rate of the Price Schedule against a joint survey; the Contractor trims locally (TQ-039).
rationale: Topographic survey ALP-SUR-TOP-001 showed the platform on average 66 mm low with a fall to the south.
title: Acceptance tolerance of the Owner-levelled platform
